name: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport

runway.v: two runways: 17R/35L 3,800 m × 45 m and 17L/35R 3,750 m × 55 m, asphalt

hours.v: aerodrome operator H24 and ATS H24

permits.v: crew must request customs entry control and immigration inspection 2 hours before the flight or arrival; aircraft operators must tell SAG (agriculture and health service) 12 hours before arrival
permits.quote: Crew must request entry control service 02 hours prior to flight or arrival

handling.v: handling on request to the handling companies
handling.quote: Upon request to the Handling Companies

notes: Source: AIP Chile Vol I AD 2 SCEL (DGAC), pages dated 15 MAY 2025 (AMDT 63) to 06 AUG 2026 (AMDT 67); DGAC IFIS page for SCEL also read (runway RWY H24, ATS 0000-2359 daily). Customs hours are not stated; the AIP only says service must be requested 2 hours ahead, so customs is left out (not marked H24). The text read covered AD 2.1-2.20 (and ended partway); AD 2.21 noise and AD 2.23 were not seen, so curfew, noise and slots stay missing. De-icing: AD 2.3 says NO but AD 2.4 says 'De icing facilities YES'; conflict, not recorded. AD 2.8: category C or larger aircraft staying over 24 hours must park on third-party aprons ('deberán hacerlo en plataformas administradas por terceros'); DGAC has no long-stay parking. AD 2.20: aircraft of 25,000 kg or more may not make 180° turns on the runway. Temporary: NOTAM A3086/26 limits RWY 17R (MON-SAT 1000-2300 EXC HOL) 30 Oct-14 Nov 2026 for asphalt repairs; SUP S16/2026 works 13-24 Oct 2026. Quotes taken via a page-reading tool.
